command: ghdl --synth --std=08 top.vhd -e top
version: GHDL 6.0.0 (tarball) [Dunoon edition]
exit: 0
--- stderr
--- stdout
library ieee;
use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;
use ieee.numeric_std.all;
entity top is
  generic (
    CLK_PERIOD: time := 10 ns;
    DEPTH: positive := 100
  );
  port (
    clk: in std_ulogic;
    rst: in std_ulogic;
    q: out std_ulogic
  );
end entity;

library ieee;
use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;
use ieee.numeric_std.all;

architecture rtl of top is
  signal wrap_clk: std_logic;
  signal wrap_rst: std_logic;
  signal wrap_q: std_logic;
  signal count : std_logic_vector (6 downto 0);
  signal n4 : std_logic;
  signal n5 : std_logic;
  signal n7 : std_logic_vector (6 downto 0);
  signal n9 : std_logic_vector (6 downto 0);
  signal n14 : std_logic;
  signal n15 : std_logic;
  signal n17 : std_logic_vector (6 downto 0);
begin
  wrap_clk <= clk;
  wrap_rst <= rst;
  q <= wrap_q;
  wrap_q <= n15;
  -- top.vhd:44:10
  count <= n17; -- (signal)
  -- top.vhd:49:29
  n4 <= '1' when count = "1100011" else '0';
  -- top.vhd:49:20
  n5 <= wrap_rst or n4;
  -- top.vhd:52:24
  n7 <= std_logic_vector (unsigned (count) + unsigned'("0000001"));
  -- top.vhd:49:7
  n9 <= n7 when n5 = '0' else "0000000";
  -- top.vhd:57:23
  n14 <= '1' when count = "0000000" else '0';
  -- top.vhd:57:12
  n15 <= '0' when n14 = '0' else '1';
  -- top.vhd:48:5
  process (wrap_clk)
  begin
    if rising_edge (wrap_clk) then
      n17 <= n9;
    end if;
  end process;
end rtl;
